name: 页面标注
description: 教 agent 在网页上做可视化标注：用宿主内置 Browser 工具注入 Shadow DOM 序号徽章与高亮框，截图回传，产出带编号的问题报告。零 UI、零工具注册，纯提示词技能。

en.name: Page Annotate
en.description: Teaches the agent to visually annotate web pages: inject Shadow DOM numbered badges and highlight boxes via the built-in Browser tool, screenshot, and produce a numbered issue report. No UI, no registered tools — a pure prompt skill.
en.safetyNotes: Declarative-only plugin: it contributes one instruction document and registers no tools, panels, or background services. The skill directs the agent to use the host's built-in Browser tool; every browser action therefore remains under the host's own permission gateway. This plugin reads no files, makes no network requests, and writes nothing.
